note: Set B binds dimensions to the correct views and components (e.g., 6'-7 1/2" and 3'-3 3/4" to the North Island elevation, 2'-5 1/16" to the Laundry Millwork section, 8'-4" to the East Island elevation) and keeps material/finish notes like 3/4" MDF GABLE FIN. W/ P3 and the 1" either-side minimum clearance intact. Set A invents or misbinds several items: SK read as "skirt," a 6" dining-table clearance, a 4'-0" width for the DIRTT Breathe wall, a 3'-0" width for DW, and MWK04 as QZ, plus a bogus "inches" unit on a finish material. Set B is weaker on redundancy (three near-duplicate 2"x6" framing claims) and two unsupported MWK04 conditions (offset from dining table, "excluding 6\" offset"), but its errors are fewer and less fundamental.
